id, flow_id, node_key, skill_id, question_template, depends_on_json, required, max_attempts, sort_order, created_at, updated_at

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow (code, name, description, task_question, summary_question_template, enabled, max_parallelism, notify_enabled, created_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{taskQuestion}, #{summaryQuestionTemplate}, #{enabled}, #{maxParallelism}, #{notifyEnabled}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_flow WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM skill_flow WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM skill_flow WHERE name = #{name} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT f.* FROM skill_flow f JOIN skill_flow_node n ON n.flow_id = f.id JOIN skill_flow_node_metric nm ON nm.flow_node_id = n.id WHERE nm.metric_id = #{metricId} AND f.enabled = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow SET code=#{code}, name=#{name}, description=#{description}, task_question=#{taskQuestion}, summary_question_template=#{summaryQuestionTemplate}, enabled=#{enabled}, max_parallelism=#{maxParallelism}, notify_enabled=#{notifyEnabled}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE skill_flow SET enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE skill_flow SET enabled=FALSE, deleted_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_node (flow_id, node_key, skill_id, question_template, depends_on_json, required, max_attempts, sort_order) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{nodeKey}, #{skillId}, #{questionTemplate}, #{dependsOnJson}, #{required}, #{maxAttempts}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_flow_node WHERE flow_id=#{flowId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM skill_flow_node_metric WHERE flow_node_id IN (SELECT id FROM skill_flow_node WHERE flow_id=#{flowId})
mapper.select: SELECT metric_id FROM skill_flow_node_metric WHERE flow_node_id=#{nodeId} ORDER BY metric_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_trigger (flow_id, keyword, normalized_keyword, priority, enabled, created_by) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{keyword}, #{normalizedKeyword}, #{priority}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_flow_trigger WHERE flow_id=#{flowId} ORDER BY priority DESC, id
SELECT FROM skill_flow_trigger WHERE normalized_keyword=#{normalizedKeyword}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_metric_readiness (metric_id, metric_code, data_date, status, ready_at, expires_at, metadata_json) VALUES (#{metricId}, #{metricCode}, #{dataDate}, #{status}, #{readyAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{metadataJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metric_code=VALUES(metric_code), status='READY', ready_at=LEAST(skill_metric_readiness.ready_at, VALUES(ready_at)), expires_at=VALUES(expires_at), metadata_json=VALUES(metadata_json), updated_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_metric_readiness WHERE metric_id=#{metricId} AND data_date=#{dataDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_execution (flow_id, flow_code, flow_name, summary_question_template_snapshot, max_parallelism_snapshot, notify_enabled_snapshot, trigger_type, trigger_user_id, conversation_id, original_question, data_date, status, active_guard_key, required_metric_count, ready_metric_count, missing_metrics_json) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{flowCode}, #{flowName}, #{summaryQuestionTemplateSnapshot}, #{maxParallelismSnapshot}, #{notifyEnabledSnapshot}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerUserId}, #{conversationId}, #{originalQuestion}, #{dataDate}, #{status}, #{activeGuardKey}, #{requiredMetricCount}, #{readyMetricCount}, #{missingMetricsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_node_execution (flow_execution_id, node_key, skill_id, skill_name, skill_retrieval_name, question_template_snapshot, rendered_question, depends_on_json, required, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_run_at) VALUES (#{flowExecutionId}, #{nodeKey}, #{skillId}, #{skillName}, #{skillRetrievalName}, #{questionTemplateSnapshot}, #{renderedQuestion}, #{dependsOnJson}, #{required}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRunAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_flow_node_execution WHERE flow_execution_id=#{flowExecutionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT t.* FROM skill_flow_trigger t JOIN skill_flow f ON f.id=t.flow_id WHERE t.enabled=TRUE AND f.enabled=TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.priority DESC,t.id
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE active_guard_key=#{guardKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE trigger_user_id=#{userId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN active_guard_key IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE trigger_user_id=#{userId} AND status=#{status} AND trigger_user_id=#{createdBy} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_execution WHERE status='WAITING_METRICS' ORDER BY id LIMIT 2000
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_node_execution WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT n.* FROM skill_flow_node_execution n JOIN skill_flow_execution e ON e.id=n.flow_execution_id WHERE (n.status IN ('QUEUED','RETRY_WAIT') OR (n.status='RUNNING' AND n.lease_expires_at <#{now})) AND (n.next_run_at IS NULL OR n.next_run_at <=#{now}) AND (n.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR n.lease_expires_at <#{now}) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill_flow_node_execution r WHERE r.flow_execution_id=n.flow_execution_id AND r.status='RUNNING' AND r.lease_expires_at>=#{now}) < e.max_parallelism_snapshot ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow_node_execution SET status='RUNNING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,lease_owner=#{owner},lease_expires_at=#{expiresAt},started_at=COALESCE(started_at,#{now}),updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND (status IN ('QUEUED','RETRY_WAIT') OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at <#{now})) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <#{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill_flow_node_execution WHERE flow_execution_id=#{flowExecutionId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at>=#{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_flow_execution SET status='SUMMARIZING',updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE skill_flow_node_attempt SET status='FAILED',retryable=TRUE,error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED',error_message='Worker lease expired before completion',completed_at=#{now} WHERE node_execution_id=#{nodeId} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_flow_node_attempt WHERE node_execution_id=#{nodeId} ORDER BY attempt_no
SELECT * FROM skill_flow_notification WHERE flow_execution_id=#{executionId} ORDER BY id DESC
